oneLine: Siddha Group plans an IPO listing by March 2028, creating potential promoter liquidity.

sources.title: Siddha Group targets ₹1,894 crore turnover by FY30; plans listing by March 2028

synopsis: Siddha Group plans to become a listed entity by March 2028 through an internal restructuring exercise involving the merger or demerger of its private real estate business into an existing listed company. Managing director Sanjay Jain stated that the company does not immediately plan to raise public-market capital or use the listing primarily for debt repayment. The developer targets a turnover of ₹1,894 crore by FY30, supported by an expanding redevelopment portfolio in Mumbai and projects across Kolkata, Jaipur, and North Bengal. The company reported a profit of over ₹18 crore in FY26 with a turnover of ₹600 crore, and estimates construction expenditure of ₹1,063 crore across three upcoming Mumbai projects.
